notes:
**The AI key screen now explains what it costs.** The model picker was there but nothing told you that the careful models spend your daily allowance much faster, that some are not offered on a free key at all, that a model missing from the list is one your key cannot call, or that removing the daily cap is a billing switch on your own Google account. Everything except the AI parts works with no key at all - that is in there too. No prices anywhere: Google's change and differ by country, and a number baked into an app would be wrong and believed.

**"Try again in a minute" when the day was gone.** A per-minute limit and a spent daily allowance both arrive as the same error and the app told you the same story for both. It now reads which one it is, never retries a spent day, and says when it comes back.

**A backtest that could not price its option was sending its hidden numbers to the AI.** When the contracts cannot be reached the report hides every rupee figure, because it is index arithmetic on a trade nobody made. The explain button was handing the model exactly those hidden numbers. It now says there is nothing to account for.
